transcript.content: I feel my new colleagues dislike me, and that I will be fired soon. I feel completely hopeless and have even thought about ending my life and leaving this world.
[Counselor] Integrating your background and the CBT therapeutic framework, let us focus on the core concerns troubling you.

known_static_traits.name: Xu Anmei
known_static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to talk with, but has not yet shared work-related fears with them; interacts little with colleagues at the new workplace and subjectively feels isolated
known_static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no history of psychotherapy/psychiatric visits
known_static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, able to self-reflect and cooperate; emotions mainly anxiety, mentions somatic discomfort of 'my stomach churns at the thought of going to work'

current_goals: These feelings of isolation and the fear of being fired are affecting my mental health and work performance; I want to feel more connected and safer at work, and to feel better about myself and my work.

core_beliefs: I am not liked / not accepted

special_situations.event: Tries to join colleagues' conversation at lunch but is brushed off
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If what I say is not warmly responded to, it means I am not liked and do not fit in
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Initiates greetings, tries to create topics to gain acceptance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not like me; I am boring

special_situations.event: Finished a project early but no one commented
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not receive recognition and praise from others, it means I did not do well enough / I have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proves himself through harder performance and increased output
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am invisible; I am still not good enough

special_situations.event: His remarks are interrupted or his opinions ignored in team meetings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my views are not adopted, it means they look down on me or do not like me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Prepares and speaks with more effort to prove his ability
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am an outsider; they exclude me

special_situations.event: Sees colleagues chatting harmoniously with each other; the atmosphere changes after he walks into the room
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they do not interact with me, it means they are talking about me/disliking me, and I will be marginalized or even fired
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to join in or win favor through work performance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They definitely do not like me; I might be fired
